findings.1: The registered preview shell supervises its child without exec, keeping its executable identity stable for the helper ticket lifetime.
findings.3: An unreadable candidate worktree aborts discovery; unresolved migration assignments prevent done publication.
findings.5: Presence admission refusals retain presence and are caught at the timer boundary; other admission timers audited.
findings.7: A shared ten-minute attempt budget covers drain/import, bounds Git subprocesses and checks before each publication, including final reopen under the gate guard.
findings.10: Retired pruning uses the same durable legacy-readiness predicate as online admission.

additional: Preserved lazy scopes: no Git/gate I/O before lifecycle work, one shared ticket per lifecycle call, generation fence remembered before reads and applied to detached children.
Computed preRegistryImport before registration, preserving the durable decision so modern worktrees do not require legacy import.
Reconciliation defers a live operation lane owned by another call token, even within the same MCP instance.
Repaired real Git/common-directory and per-call admission fixtures; isolated adapter-neutral manifest metadata ownership entries.
Added undefined-directory non-lifecycle broadcast coverage; fixture restores its directory before unrelated shutdown cleanup.
Made preview mode preparation observable through a named helper after the admission wrapper changed the stack; responsiveness assertions unchanged.
Non-repository startup defers storage registration until a repository is joinable, preserving the friendly remedy and recheck-on-next-call behavior.
Solo-room fixture closes storage registrations before deleting its gate between tests.
timerAudit: PresenceEnd tick: catches conservative admission failure; interval catches unexpected errors.
File store background reconciliation: catches/stops on gate refusal.
Worker projector: explicit ticket before read-to-CRDT effects; pass catches errors; no-fence no-op remains free.
Bridge scheduler, conflict-set timer, messaging wait callbacks: rejection paths handled.
Preview sweep: detached ticket created in awaited entry; background child catches failure.
Idle release: explicit ticket spans read-to-leave effects.
validationNotes: Local checks are iterative evidence at successive revisions, not a single final-source full suite run.
Sandbox cannot listen on sockets or read native process identity. A direct tsx CLI probe reproduced EPERM for its IPC socket, explaining non-repo MCP connection closure.
Local typecheck cannot see the collected peer reopen(owner,{notAfter}) signature; combined preview typecheck passes.
All previews omit generated plugin assets because of sharing/read limits. Source-test results do not certify a complete integrated/release tree.
Full integrated suite and plugin rebuild remain with the lead. No timeout or correctness assertion was relaxed.
Group 2 tools teardown and mode-preparation probe failures were fixed and passed group 4; group 3 non-repo startup and solo fixture failures were fixed and passed group 4.
